newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best reviewing two insurance cos ratings.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best reviewing two insurance cos ratings.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said Friday it has placed under review its A- (excellent) ratings on Washington National Insurance Co and United Presidential Life Insurance Co with developing implications in light of a proposed merger between its parent company and PennCorp Financial Group Inc.
The two companies are owned by Washington National Corp. The transaction is valued at about $400 million. It is expected to be completed during the first quarter of 1997.

A.M. Best said the ratings of the life insurance subsidiaries of PennCorp, which range from B+ to A- (excellent), are not affected, reflecting the expectation that there will be little strategic disruption or significant increase of financial leverage to PennCorp.
